messages.author: d763070a68ca6a43
messages.subject: Tracking local source packages
parts:
Hi all,

I'm wondering how exactly to get packrat to track local packages.

Here it says that you should use the parameter source.packages: http://rstudio.github.io/packrat/limitations.html

The problem is, I don't know what function this parameter belongs to.

I tried this:

packrat::install_local("mylocalpackage_1.0.tar.gz", repos="my_repos")
packrat::snapshot()

The package is indeed installed to the packrat library, but my packrat.lock file does not contain any information on mylocalpackage.

Thanks,
Janko

messages.author: ab0d2be2ea8dabe8
messages.subject: Re: Tracking local source packages
parts:
Hi Janko,

Sorry, this documentation is out of date! You should be using:

    ## Initiate a new project with local repositories (directories containing source packages)
    packrat::init(options = list(local.repos = c(<path_to_local_repos>)))

or

    ## Add a local repository to an existing project
    packrat::opts$local.repos(c(<path_to_local_repos>))

Thanks,
Kevin
